method: 45 tokens of each type drawn at random from the tagged corpus (seed in mna.atlas_types.sample) and read in context by the atlas session; an error is a token that does not belong to its type as defined in src/mna/atlas_types.py
limit: 45 tokens per type bound an error rate of zero only below about 6.4% (95%)
rule_changes: a number directly before a dose unit became its own type, because 38% of numbers were section or table references
bare kg, units per dL or per L, and mL/min are no longer dose units, because 31% of numbers before a unit were body weights or lab values
lowercase injection is no longer a dosage form, because 13% of form tokens were the act of injecting

types.note: one general-text phrase, 24 hours a day
all are digits or number punctuation; 17 of 45 are section or table references and 4 are digits inside a name such as CYP2C9
9 of 45 are containers (vial, syringe), which the type includes
